title: Canonical Signal Record
description: Schema for a canonical signal file in .moeb/signals/catalogue/.

signal_id.description: UUID v4. Also the filename stem: <signal_id>.signal.json.

signal_source.description: Origin of the signal. 'moeb': relates to the moeb harness itself (baseline rubric criteria, skill execution quality, tool capability gaps, kernel behaviour). 'project': relates to the project under development with moeb (project-specific rubric criteria, layers 3-4). Default when indeterminate: 'moeb'.

status.description: open: active, not yet addressed. in_progress: signal_fix has been started for this signal. resolved: fixed and closed. reopened: was resolved but regressed. superseded: replaced by a different signal (see links). spec_written: a spec exists targeting this signal, not yet run. candidate: a run produced a candidate tag, awaiting acceptance. rejected: intentionally not going to be addressed.
